name: Zhejiang Weigang Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Weigang Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of label printing equipment. Its products include full-rotary offset printing machines, intermittent label offset printing machines, flexographic printing machines, and screen printing machines. The company was founded on April 24, 2007 and is headquartered in Wenzhou, China.
